+def remove_author_honorifics(name: str) -> str:
+    """Remove a leading honorific when a name follows it."""
+    normalized = re.sub(r'[\W_]+', ' ', name).strip().casefold()
+    if normalized in {
+        re.sub(r'[\W_]+', ' ', exception).strip().casefold()
+        for exception in HONORIFC_NAME_EXECPTIONS
+    }:
+        return name
+    for honorific in HONORIFICS:
+        if match := re.match(
+            rf'^\s*{re.escape(honorific)}[\s,:]+(?=\S)', name, re.IGNORECASE
+        ):
+            return name[match.end() :]
+    return name
